how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-badlands-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:692:obj:0: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.
rows.quest:692:details:0: The Scroll of ⟦E1⟧...the Scroll of ⟦E1⟧?! You don't want that! Its magic can pull ⟦E1⟧ to the surface world and if you do that, we are in trouble!
rows.quest:692:details:1: BOr...maybe it's too late. Maybe she already is free. Maybe she's just gathering strength before unleashing herself upon us. If so, then you'll NEED the scroll!
rows.quest:692:details:2: B...too bad it's destroyed. Enraged elementals stole it and tore it up and now fight over the fragments.
rows.quest:692:details:3: BBut if you can gather those fragments, maybe we can fix it...
rows.quest:692:completion:0: Ah, you found them! Good work, ⟦1⟧! These might be the only chance we have against the evil of ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:692:completion:1: BJust let me find my scrap-ratchet and see if I can re-attach these fragments...
rows.quest:703:details:0: Oh yes, my barbecued buzzard wings are a favorite! The sauce is rich and the meat is tangy. And the smell will bring the hungry running from miles away!
rows.quest:703:details:1: BI have everything I need to cook up a batch. Everything...except the buzzard wings!
rows.quest:703:details:2: BIf you want some then get me the buzzard wings. Bring me enough, and I might even share the recipe with you!
rows.quest:703:completion:0: Ah, I'll get started on those wings right away. I can almost taste them already!
rows.quest:703:completion:1: BAnd here's the recipe in case you want to make them yourself!
rows.quest:705:obj:0: Bring 9 Blue Pearls to Rigglefuzz in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:705:details:0: The ⟦E2⟧ is a harsh place, filled with vicious predators and bold scavengers. Scary, especially for a short little goblin. To survive, I have to be tricky!
rows.quest:705:details:1: BI know the recipe for flash bombs. I use those to scare away wildlife. But I'm running low on one of the ingredients: crushed blue pearl powder. Get me some and I'll make it worth your efforts.
rows.quest:705:details:2: BHeh, and I hope you have good boots on. The Blue Pearls I need are found from clams at the Vile Reef.
rows.quest:705:details:3: BYep, the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn!
rows.quest:705:completion:0: These will work great! I just need to smash them into powder...then mix them with a little of this and a little of that.
rows.quest:705:completion:1: BWatch out, scavengers! Prepare to be flashed!
rows.quest:706:obj:0: Acquire a Black Drake's Heart for Sigrun Ironhew.
rows.quest:706:details:0: As an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, I learned his special technique for imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments. Last I heard of him, he was working at a smithy with a hunting party up in Lordaeron.
rows.quest:706:details:1: BI can't tell you too many of the details about the process, but I can tell you it requires blood from a rare, still-beating black drake whelp's heart. I don't have much to do waiting for word from ⟦E3⟧. If you bring me a heart from the whelps in Lethlor Ravine, I'll show you my skill!
rows.quest:706:completion:0: Ah yes, this will do excellently. This will enable your weapons to strike with searing heat!
rows.quest:708:obj:0: Take the Corroded Black Box to the Hall of ⟦E4⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:708:details:0: The surface of this metallic black box is heavily pitted, as if it had been immersed in acid - it must have been sitting in the giant condor's stomach for a long time.
rows.quest:708:details:1: BTurning the box over, a symbol is found stamped on its bottom. Below the symbol are the words:
rows.quest:710:obj:0: Find 10 Small Stone Shards and bring them to Lotwil Veriatus in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:710:details:0: Here in the ⟦E2⟧ I've stopped to work on my latest project: my shackles of elemental binding.
rows.quest:710:details:1: BWhen complete, they will allow mages to summon even more powerful elementals for use in even greater capacities. To start things off, I need small stone shards to test some of my newest offensive spells along with a few gizmos I've pieced together.
rows.quest:710:details:2: BThe shards are easily collected from the lesser rock elementals to the west of here. Could you bring me some?
rows.quest:710:completion:0: These shall do nicely, ⟦2⟧. Thank you. Hmm, a bit more sand than I'd anticipated. Have to adjust the coefficient of friction. No, wait; it should still be negligible with the frost oil.
rows.quest:710:completion:1: B<Mumbling to himself, Lotwil puts one fist into the palm of his other hand and stares at them as if fascinated.>
rows.quest:711:obj:0: Bring 3 Large Stone Slabs to Lotwil Veriatus in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:711:details:0: ⟦3⟧, you've already proven more able than all my apprentices combined.
rows.quest:711:details:1: BThe next parts I need require a little more strength. Large stone slabs can be found on rock elementals if you're careful enough. Their bodies are stronger and larger, and therefore more prone to having pieces large enough for my tests. You can find them further west of here or southeast along the mountains' edges.
rows.quest:711:details:2: BTake your time; I'll need a while to test these smaller pieces you brought me.
rows.quest:711:completion:0: ⟦4⟧, simply amazing! I would have thought it'd take half a dozen tauren to bring all these to me.
rows.quest:712:obj:0: Bring 5 Bracers of Rock Binding to Lotwil Veriatus in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:712:details:0: ⟦5⟧, there's one more part I need from the elementals here in the ⟦E2⟧: the bracers of rock binding from the greater rock elementals. By my calculations, those bracers should be enough to gauge the strength of my own shackles.
rows.quest:712:details:1: BMy attempts at scrying the greater rock elementals showed a group of them southwest of here, near some ogres if I recall.
rows.quest:712:details:2: BBring me 5 of their bracers just so I have extras. Servo's notorious for misplacing my reagents and research.
rows.quest:712:completion:0: ⟦6⟧, have you ever considered becoming a research assistant? No? I'm not sure what I'll do without your abilities here. Intelligence, curiosity, and strength--all combined into one package.
rows.quest:713:obj:0: Find ⟦E5⟧ and bring it to Lotwil Veriatus in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:713:details:0: Let me tell you something about ⟦E5⟧: nothing can keep an engine or gears from overheating quite like it.
rows.quest:713:details:1: BIts cooling properties are extraordinary, and its longevity as a lubricant without equal. That's not all: it also aids in retaining enchantments on magical items.
rows.quest:713:details:2: BI need a vial of it to increase the magical capacity of my shackles and make them powerful enough to stop our summoned friend from killing us all.
rows.quest:713:details:3: BBro'kin, a goblin friend of mine, can teach you to make it. He's in Alterac.
rows.quest:713:completion:0: Stupendous! This should be the perfect coolant for my new bracers. If the enchantments don't last a century, then I'll give all my belongings to Servo.
rows.quest:713:completion:1: BAll the mages of the Assembly will be in such awe after I finish this, ⟦7⟧. You just wait and see.
rows.quest:714:obj:0: Bring a Gyrochronatom to Lotwil Veriatus in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:714:details:0: ⟦8⟧, you've done your job well beyond all standards.
rows.quest:714:details:1: B<Lotwil's obviously distracted by his work.>
rows.quest:714:details:2: BIf we ever meet in Kharanos, feel free to come apply for work.
rows.quest:714:details:3: BWhoops! Quick, grab the... yes, that. Thanks.
rows.quest:714:details:4: BNow I just need one more thing. It's a small part, but rather crucial, I'm afraid: a gyrochronatom.
rows.quest:714:details:5: BIf you could just go grab one and bring it to me, I should be ready to complete this.
rows.quest:714:completion:1: B<Lotwil grabs the gyrochronatom from you.>
rows.quest:714:completion:2: BPerfect... just about done. No, really. I AM almost done now. This project is my top priority... at the moment. Let me pop this into place, and you can see for yourself what you've helped me create. It'll just take me a few more minutes... maybe... possibly longer. Well, maybe a lot longer. We'll see...
rows.quest:715:obj:0: Bring a Healing Potion and a ⟦E6⟧ Potion to Lucien Tosselwrench in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:715:details:0: I'm thinking those items you acquired for Lotwil are going to be the least of our worries, ⟦9⟧. On the other hand, you've proven more than adept at the sciences Lotwil holds sacred, so how about helping me out?
rows.quest:715:details:1: BI need an ⟦E7⟧ potion and a healing potion; both might come in handy real soon if he pulls this off.
rows.quest:715:details:2: BIn return, I'll give you this recipe for a potion I've been developing while learning from Lotwil. It's based on some of the research he's been doing here in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:715:completion:1: BI mean, thank you, ⟦10⟧. These will be helpful while traveling through the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:716:obj:0: Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:716:details:0: I know how cheap Lotwil can be, ⟦11⟧, so let me make you something for all your troubles. Maybe it'll even help protect you from the coming atrocity that is Lotwil's newest invention.
rows.quest:716:details:1: BI've been working with all the extra stones you collected for him, and I can make some nice bracers that you might want to use. They're enchanted, of course.
rows.quest:716:details:2: BI'll just need patterned bronze bracers crafted by a blacksmith so I can complete the bracers I'm making for you.
rows.quest:716:completion:0: Here you go, ⟦12⟧. Try these on.
rows.quest:717:desc:2: Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Garek.
rows.quest:717:obj:0: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal, and Diamond and obtain the Runestones.
rows.quest:717:obj:1: BPlace the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.
rows.quest:717:obj:2: BSlay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Garek.
rows.quest:717:details:0: It has become obvious that we cannot ensure that Blacklash and Hematus will remain imprisoned in Lethlor. That black dragons have taken up residence there, and that the ogres managed to steal the Sign indicates that more drastic measures will have to be taken.
rows.quest:717:details:1: BThe drakes' prison is maintained by three runestones that may only be retrieved using the Sign of the Earth. Those runestones can then be used to break the seal which imprisons them.
rows.quest:717:details:2: B⟦13⟧... assure that their dreams are eternal.
rows.quest:717:completion:0: No longer will the Kirin ⟦E8⟧ need to worry over the prisoners of Lethlor. I will return to report success to my master. Krasus will no doubt be pleased.
rows.quest:718:obj:0: Retrieve the Supply Crate for Sigrun Ironhew.
rows.quest:718:details:0: In our hurry to leave the Uldaman excavation site, we were forced to abandon many wagons and crates of supplies along the way. The local ogres from Camp Kosh have been on our abandoned equipment like vultures on a rotting corpse. Don't smell much better, either. Than the corpses, I mean.
rows.quest:718:details:1: BAnyways, they took the cart that was carrying all our weapons and such... so--well, this is a bit embarrassing--we haven't been able to get any food.
rows.quest:718:details:2: BWe're in a bit of a pickle here, suppose you could help us out?
rows.quest:718:completion:0: Thanks so much, ⟦14⟧. While you were gone, I... er... swallowed a mouthful of sand. It...
rows.quest:718:completion:1: BWell, enough of that, we'll go out and get some food tonight. Eat like kings!
rows.quest:719:obj:0: Find Ryedol's Lucky Pick and return it to Prospector Ryedol south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.
rows.quest:719:details:0: Hey, ⟦15⟧. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.
rows.quest:719:details:1: BThey just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. I barely escaped with me life.
rows.quest:719:details:2: BThe site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.
rows.quest:719:details:3: BThink you'd be up to helpin' me out some? One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! Could be anyone of them.
rows.quest:719:completion:0: Ye're me savior, ⟦16⟧. I'm glad someone could teach those Shadowforge a lesson or two. Thanks for yer help.
rows.quest:720:obj:0: Find Prospector Ryedol and let him know Hammertoe Grez is alive.
rows.quest:720:details:0: <There is text roughly scribbled in chalk on the map.>
rows.quest:720:details:1: B"Ryedol, ⟦17⟧They're taking me to Uldaman. Send help.⟦18⟧-Hammertoe"
rows.quest:723:obj:0: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:723:details:0: <Hammertoe holds his wounds and takes a moment to regain his composure before speaking again.>
rows.quest:723:details:1: BFind Ryedol, ⟦20⟧. Bring 'im me amulet. ⟦21⟧ He'll... ⟦22⟧ figure out what to do. He knows I was seeking the origins of our people, and he... ⟦23⟧... knows it was also my mission to stop the Shadowforge clan. They must not be allowed to find the scrolls... ⟦24⟧
rows.quest:723:completion:0: Hammertoe's amulet? I think my spirits were higher when I thought he was dead. Knowin' fer sure only makes the pain worse. This amulet was his life's work. I can't let his death be in vain.
rows.quest:724:obj:0: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Historian Karnik in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:724:details:0: Okay, okay... who would know what to do?
rows.quest:724:details:2: BHe's in ⟦E3⟧. He'll be able to help. He and Hammertoe were workin' together to find the lost artifacts in Uldaman.
rows.quest:724:details:3: BGuess the Shadowforge found out the two of them knew more than they were lettin' on.
rows.quest:724:details:4: BTell Karnik what's happened to Hammertoe and give him the amulet--he'll tell you what needs to be done next.
rows.quest:724:completion:0: Oh! Well, this is a different matter entirely. You probably don't realize the gravity of this matter yet, do you?
rows.quest:724:completion:1: BI care deeply about Hammertoe's demise, but if he sent you here with his amulet, then he understood what's at stake.
rows.quest:724:completion:2: BWe will have to take time to mourn his death later.
rows.quest:724:completion:3: BLet me show you one of the reasons this amulet is so valuable.
rows.quest:725:obj:0: Find Advisor Belgrum and give him his note.
rows.quest:725:details:0: ⟦25⟧, run and find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can. Tell him what you've witnessed and ask him how he wants us to proceed. This note will explain more to him.
rows.quest:725:details:1: BIn the meantime, I will take the time to speak to Hammertoe's spirit. Maybe he knows something that will help us put a stop to those Shadowforge cretins' activities in the ⟦E2⟧. We can only pray.
rows.quest:725:completion:0: Ah, word from Historian Karnik. Excellent.
rows.quest:725:completion:1: BI always have time for his business.
rows.quest:725:completion:2: B<Advisor Belgrum opens the note and begins to read.>
rows.quest:726:details:0: <Advisor Belgrum reaches the end of the note, and his eyes widen for a moment.>
rows.quest:726:details:2: B⟦26⟧, please return to Historian Karnik and tell him on the king's authority to act on this information swiftly and decisively. He must halt the Shadowforge's activities in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:726:completion:0: You're treating this matter with an urgency I'd expect from the king himself, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:726:completion:1: BAll right, then. I know what'll bring the Shadowforge down.
rows.quest:726:completion:2: BTheir presence in Uldaman can be slowed if we strike them at their base of operations: Angor Fortress.
rows.quest:727:obj:0: Give the Sigil of the ⟦E9⟧ to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:727:details:0: The Tablet tells much. But not enough! Not nearly enough!
rows.quest:727:details:1: BThere is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. The ... people I fled ... they keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. It holds vast knowledge. Knowledge to protect us!
rows.quest:727:details:2: BGo to Gerrig Bonegrip. He is in a shop in ⟦E3⟧, in the Forlorn Cavern. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. Ask him for Yagyin's Digest ... and bring it to me!
rows.quest:727:completion:1: BAnd praise to the dwellers beneath.
rows.quest:728:obj:0: Bring the Sigil of the ⟦E9⟧ to Keeper Bel'dugur in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:728:details:0: The tablet tells much. But not enough! Not nearly enough!
rows.quest:728:details:1: BThere is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. The... people I fled from... they keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. It holds vast knowledge. Knowledge to protect us!
rows.quest:728:details:2: BGo to Keeper Bel'dugur in the ⟦E10⟧ of Lordaeron. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. Ask him for Yagin's Digest...and bring it to me!
rows.quest:728:completion:0: Be discrete with your signs, ⟦28⟧. There are those who do not believe the righteousness of our pledge.
rows.quest:728:completion:1: BAnd there are those who would see us fail if they knew of us.
rows.quest:728:completion:2: BWe must always be careful. And watchful. And patient.
rows.quest:732:obj:0: Retrieve the Sign of the Earth for Garek.
rows.quest:732:details:0: I heard from Sigrun that you have been a great help to him. Perhaps I might enlist your help. I was sent here by my master, Krasus of the Kirin ⟦E8⟧, to put an end to the trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine.
rows.quest:732:details:1: BI cannot divulge the exact nature of my assignment here or the tasks that I must undertake, but be assured it is of vital importance.
rows.quest:732:details:2: BA band of wandering ogres, sometimes seen near Camp Boff, stole an object called the Sign of the Earth; I must have it. Bring it to me, and I will tell you more.
rows.quest:732:completion:0: Good tidings you bring bearing the Sign, ⟦29⟧. The Sign of the Earth was created by the Dark Iron dwarves of Angor Fortress to bind two of ⟦E11⟧'s ruthless lieutenants, the twins Blacklash and Hematus.
rows.quest:733:obj:0: Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.
rows.quest:733:details:0: It's going to be tough going here if I can't manage to scrounge up some materials to construct some defenses and other necessities. I've noticed that the ogres in the area seem to be well equipped with scrap metal. Maybe the stories of siege engines in the ⟦E2⟧ weren't so far off after all...
rows.quest:733:details:1: BAnyways, the Prospector's been getting worried about the state of our little camp, so I'd like to get working soon if I can.
rows.quest:733:details:2: BThe main ogre camp is at Dustbelch Grotto, a good trek to the west of here.
rows.quest:733:completion:0: It's a start, ⟦30⟧, and it'll have to do until we hear word from ⟦E3⟧ or the Explorers' League.
rows.quest:733:completion:1: BNow, if only I could find some salt somewhere for my quenching barrel...
rows.quest:734:obj:0: Speak to Lucien Tosselwrench in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:734:details:1: B<Lotwil looks up at you for a moment before going back to his shackles.>
rows.quest:734:details:2: BGo speak to Lucien, ⟦31⟧. I need a cog #5. Bring it to me, will you?
rows.quest:734:completion:0: Cog #5, huh? Yeah, this isn't going to be good.
rows.quest:735:obj:0: Return the items on the Bonegrip's Note to Gerrig Bonegrip in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:735:details:0: Yagyin's Digest, eh? Are you starting a new chapter of us, somewhere? Never mind, it is not my place to ask.
rows.quest:735:details:1: BI will help you, for I have an extra copy. We must aid each other, yes? That is how we flourish.
rows.quest:735:details:2: BI require three items of power. Bring them to me and I will give you the digest.
rows.quest:735:details:3: BI will not speak their names. Ears may be on us. But here, I will write them down.
rows.quest:735:completion:0: You are resourceful, ⟦32⟧. If it truly is your charge to begin a new chapter of our order, then I believe you will run it well.
rows.quest:737:details:0: I have the digest for you, ⟦33⟧. I need not tell you to take great care with it. And to keep it far from unfriendly hands.
rows.quest:737:completion:0: You got it! Oh, hope glimmers!
rows.quest:737:completion:1: BYour efforts may yet save us, ⟦34⟧. A monument they should make of you! A shrine they should build! May your name be praised until your grandchildren have grandchildren!
rows.quest:737:completion:2: BUnless...THEY are freed and rise to the surface. If that happens then you can forget about children.
rows.quest:737:completion:3: BIf THEY are freed, then we're all worm food.
rows.quest:738:details:0: Prospector Agmond was in charge of our excavation sites in the ⟦E2⟧, to the southwest. I say "was" because...well, I haven't heard from him in weeks. I need you to find Agmond so I can get his report.
rows.quest:738:details:1: BLast I heard Agmond was at the southernmost dig site in the ⟦E2⟧--a tiny operation past the Angor Fortress. I'd start your search for him there.
rows.quest:738:completion:0: This skeleton must be the unfortunate remains of Agmond. His body is broken and battered, and his bones picked clean.
rows.quest:739:details:0: Agmond's tracks lead from the west. It is easy to tell from the bloody smears across rock and sand that the dwarf crawled some distance.
rows.quest:739:details:2: BUpon close inspection, the word "Murdaloc" is roughly scrawled in a patch of ⟦E2⟧ sandstone.
rows.quest:739:details:3: BScrawled next to Agmond's dead hand.
rows.quest:739:completion:0: This is sobering news, ⟦35⟧. But Agmond had a strong arm and a fierce hammer-swing, and his skull was as thick as they come! Although he was killed by those cursed troggs I'm sure he took a lot of them down with him.
rows.quest:762:obj:0: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:762:details:0: Ambassador Infernus was sent to Angor Fortress by Ragnaros himself to mind the Shadowforge seeking lost artifacts in Uldaman.
rows.quest:762:details:1: BIt has already meant tremendous casualties for our people, but it has obviously grown worse. I hesitate to guess how many artifacts they would be able to find and use against ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:762:details:2: BOur goal is simple, ⟦36⟧. Return to the ⟦E2⟧ and destroy Ambassador Infernus. Once the threat is eliminated, return to Advisor Belgrum with proof of your victory.
rows.quest:762:details:3: BIt is in your hands now.
rows.quest:762:completion:0: ⟦37⟧, your dedication to ⟦E3⟧ and to the dwarven people cannot be refuted. I thank you for your help in this matter.
rows.quest:762:completion:1: BI shall send word to Historian Karnik informing him that you have succeeded, and I shall also have aid sent to the ⟦E2⟧ as soon as possible to help recover the excavation site. Thank you again.
rows.quest:762:completion:2: BBefore you go, there is one more thing I would ask of you in the name of King Bronzebeard.
rows.quest:777:details:1: BI'm going to be over here... behind cover.
rows.quest:777:completion:0: Ah, perfect. Stand back while I prepare to make more history!
rows.quest:778:obj:0: Defeat the Fam'retor Guardian and bring Lotwil's Shackles of Elemental Binding back to Lotwil Veriatus.
rows.quest:778:details:0: Haha! Done! The shackles are done!
rows.quest:778:details:1: BIt's time, Lucien. It's time, Servo!
rows.quest:778:details:2: BAre you ready to bear witness to the perfect blend of alchemy, engineering, and the arcane, ⟦38⟧?
rows.quest:778:details:3: BI shall summon forth a powerful elemental now. This is a groundbreaking day for all of us.
rows.quest:778:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦39⟧. That was quite an ordeal, wasn't it?
rows.quest:778:completion:1: BI'm not sure what could have gone wrong. It was a good thing my magics were here to help send the creature back to its home plane.
rows.quest:778:completion:2: BPerhaps a little token of appreciation for all your hard work...
rows.quest:782:obj:0: Kill Boss Tho'grun and bring the Sign of the Earth to Gorn in Kargath.
rows.quest:782:details:0: From the ⟦E14⟧'s alliance with the dragon ⟦E11⟧ during the Second War, we know that two of his lieutenants, Blacklash and Hematus, were imprisoned within Lethlor Ravine far to the east. We must silence our depraved allies of old to restore honor to the ⟦E14⟧!
rows.quest:782:details:1: BWe hired Tho'grun and his band of ogre mercenaries to help us obtain the Sign of the Earth, a key needed to unlock the drakes' prison. Tho'grun betrayed us though, overwhelming us and taking it for himself. Go to Camp Boff and take it back!
rows.quest:782:completion:0: With Tho'grun dead, his corpse picked clean by the desert winds and scavenging buzzards, the ogres will be put into disarray. Though a small victory, this will lead to a much larger one
rows.quest:782:completion:1: BThe Sign of the Earth is now in our possession, and we can open the black drakes' prison in Lethlor. We shall free them from endless imprisonment, albeit to their doom!
rows.quest:793:desc:2: Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn.
rows.quest:793:obj:0: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.
rows.quest:793:obj:1: BPlace the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.
rows.quest:793:obj:2: BSlay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn.
rows.quest:793:details:0: The Seal of the Earth is held by three runestones, held in the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst in Lethlor Ravine. Using the Sign of the Earth, you will be able to remove the runestones and unlock the Seal of the Earth.
rows.quest:793:details:1: BBe wary though, ⟦40⟧, the black drakes Blacklash and Hematus are not to be trifled with. See them dead and return their bindings to me.
rows.quest:793:details:2: BTo reach the ravine, travel to the far eastern part of the ⟦E2⟧. Be careful though, for the ravine is home to countless drakes.
rows.quest:793:completion:0: The black dragonflight continues to ally with the renegade Blackrock orcs, and both must be brought into line, or removed. With Blacklash and Hematus dead, we can turn our attentions westwards, towards Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:1419:obj:0: Bring 30 Coyote Jawbones to Neeka Bloodscar in Kargath.
rows.quest:1419:details:0: Have you spent many days in the ⟦E2⟧, ⟦41⟧? Have you felt its heat? Have you faced the beasts that wander its dusty plains? It's time you did.
rows.quest:1419:details:1: BCrag coyotes are a tough breed. Tough, and bold enough to creep into Kargath and steal from our food supplies. Help rid the outpost of these thieves!
rows.quest:1419:details:2: BHunt crag coyotes, ⟦42⟧. Hunt them and bring me their jawbones. Bring me enough, and maybe I'll believe it when you say you know the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1419:completion:0: That's a nice collection of jawbones, ⟦43⟧. Now those coyotes won't be tearing through our supplies for scraps.
rows.quest:1419:completion:1: BWell done. The coyotes of the ⟦E2⟧ aren't easy prey. Your deed shows me that you might just survive here.
rows.quest:1420:obj:0: Bring Neeka's Report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.
rows.quest:1420:details:0: I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard. Bring it to him.
rows.quest:1420:details:1: BAnd if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way. Or fall to an enemy.
rows.quest:1420:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦44⟧. From Neeka's report, I see the ⟦E15⟧ is not without its own problems. And we may find that some enemies are shared between us.
rows.quest:2203:obj:0: Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the ⟦E2⟧. Once you have them filled, bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.
rows.quest:2203:details:0: You have been most helpful to me, ⟦45⟧. I would reward you with the very recipe for the brew I gave you earlier... but I would ask of you a task that is quite dangerous. Hear my request.
rows.quest:2203:details:1: BThis lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon. Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be warned. Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.
rows.quest:2203:details:2: BDo this, and the recipe will be yours.
rows.quest:2203:completion:0: From one alchemist to another, I salute you. Here, take this recipe and commit it to your knowledge. May it bring you the success and rewards that it has brought me over the years.
rows.quest:2258:obj:0: Bring 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs, and 5 Rock Elemental Shards to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2258:details:0: ⟦46⟧, I could use your aid if you're up for it. I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2258:details:1: BI need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards. Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.
rows.quest:2258:details:2: BAcquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal. Watcha wanna do?
rows.quest:2258:completion:0: Ah, well done! These should last me for a little while, at least. Here is your pay as promised.
rows.quest:2258:completion:1: BIf you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use. These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation. They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.
rows.quest:2258:completion:2: BPerhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?
rows.quest:3821:obj:0: Venture forth to the ⟦E16⟧ and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.
rows.quest:3821:details:0: Sha'ni was sent to investigate reports of strange ritualistic activity coming from the Firegut ogres of the ⟦E16⟧ over three weeks ago.
rows.quest:3821:details:1: BGoretooth tells me that he hasn't heard from anyone in that platoon and that it's best that I move on and focus on the task at hand. Can you believe it? That's my wife!
rows.quest:3821:details:2: BI can't leave my post, ⟦47⟧, but I must know what became of Sha'ni. ⟦E17⟧ to the ⟦E16⟧ and search for her.
rows.quest:3821:completion:1: BWe were planning on moving in with my mother and father in the Hinterlands after our tours were over. Now those plans are ruined!
rows.quest:4062:obj:0: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
rows.quest:4062:obj:1: BYou recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.⟦48⟧
rows.quest:4062:details:1: BThose are the 'initials' imprinted on the elemental shards. Below the initials are a rank marking of some sort. The machinations you destroyed in the ⟦E16⟧ were of 'Rank IV.' I assume that this is a lowly rank.
rows.quest:4062:details:2: BTake this shard sample to Lotwil Veriatus in the camp to the east. He is a scholar of some renown in the field of elemental sciences. He may be able to assist us in our search.
